comparison.objective: Configure a dual-opening seasoning bottle and dispense a safe dose onto food.
comparison.physical_skill: Inspect and operate flip covers, reorient the bottle, and control pouring through apertures.
comparison.success_condition: Positive dose no greater than 2 g on the steak earns full credit; overdose earns partial credit. No detailed spec version is present.
comparison.reason: It tests opening selection, reorientation, and granular dispensing rather than mechanical locking and response-based tuning.
